messages: anya: Quick design review snapshot — playground streaming UX + prompt library quick-insert. Idea set: (1) clarify Pause vs Stop semantics, (2) move token counter into composer as a trailing pill instead of rail, (3) preserve partial generation as editable draft when user hits Stop, and (4) keyboard shortcut for prompt quick-insert (Cmd+\u005c). Screenshot + prototype in Figma link: https://figma.com/redwood/playground-stream-v2 ben: love the draft-preserve idea. smaller asks: microcopy options for the action (we should pick 1): - Pause (temporarily halt stream, keep connection open) - Stop (abort generation, keep partial text as draft) - Regenerate (start a new generation, keep original in history) ben: my quick mock: inline controls to the left of the composer, token pill on the right. Proposed microcopy on button: `⏸ Pause` / `⏹ Stop` / `🔁 Regenerate`. maria: small product note — when Stop preserves a partial, it should be saved only locally (client draft) unless user explicitly sends. We want to avoid accidental submissions that re-run a partially generated hallucination. Also: regen should spawn a new generation entry in history rather than overwriting. maria: also, prompt quick-insert: Cmd+\\ opens the prompt drawer, arrow keys to navigate, Enter to insert. If user has focus in editor, it should insert inline and place caret after inserted prompt. sam: engineering constraints: backend abort flows need to distinguish Pause vs Stop. Pause = keep stream open (we buffer on client), Stop = send cancellation token -> server abort and free KV cache slot. Important: Stop must still report consumed tokens to billing metric so we don't under/over-charge. I'll add an "abort_reason" tag to the span. sam: quick note about partial-preserve: we should mark preserved drafts with metadata `partial=true` so downstream analytics know it was a stopped generation. linda: accessibility notes: keyboard focus order must hit controls before composer, and the token pill must be reachable via Tab. For screen readers: announce start/stop/regenerate via aria-live. Example snippet: ``` Tokens: 120 ``` linda: when Stop preserves partial text, screen reader should say: "Generation stopped — partial content available as draft." When Regenerate completes: "New generation finished." These small phrases help context for NVDA/VoiceOver users. ben: UX question — token pill: show live tokens while streaming, then shrink to icon-only when not streaming? Feels less noisy. Also we could show token delta when regen completes (e.g., +84 tokens). maria: agree. Also accessibility: token delta should be readable by screen readers (announce +84 tokens used). sam: back-end implication: token delta requires us to compute end - start on server and emit a final event. I'll hook it into the existing metrics pipeline. Edge case: if Stop aborts early, emit `tokens_consumed` with `aborted=true`. ben: small copy candidates for the confirmation toast after Stop: "Generation stopped. Partial content preserved as draft." OR "Stopped — partial response saved locally." pick shorter for mobile. linda: prefer the first one, it's clearer. anya: action items: 1) ben update mocks with token pill collapse + microcopy (ETA EOD), 2) maria runs quick moderated test for 3 flows (pause, stop->preserve, regenerate) — target 5 users, 3 tasks, 3 days, 3) sam implements abort tag + metric, and ensures billing delta correctness, 4) linda writes aria snippets + keyboard nav doc. I'll book a 30m follow-up Fri 9am PT. ben: noted. I'll push updated frames to Figma and ping here. :thumbsup: maria: will prep 3 task script and post recruiter ask in research channel. sam: will spike the abort + tokens flag; might need a small runtime change if the client-side Pause requires new websocket keepalive. linda: will draft accessibility checklist and test cases (NVDA/VoiceOver + keyboard only). deploy-bot: Reminder: "Product design review — Playground streaming" scheduled Fri 09:00 PT. RSVP +1 if attending. anya: thanks all — keeping thread open for quick comments.
